messages:
sam: Heads-up — invoice preview shows ~2k missing tenant credits for last night's window. Looks like late-arrival credits from the ingest topic never made it to the ledger aggregation.

jess: Which pipeline/topic? can you paste a sample event or offset? was the consumer group healthy during the window?

sam: Topic is `billing.credits.v1`. Sample event id: evt_abc123 offset=145789 partition=6. Quick kafka-tail I ran:
```
kafka-console-consumer --topic billing.credits.v1 --partition 6 --offset 145780 --max-messages 20 --bootstrap-server kafka:9092
# shows evt_abc120..evt_abc140, missing evt_abc123 in ledger join
```

leo: I pulled consumer-group lag for billing-agg around 03:10-03:20 UTC — there was a spike. Group `billing-agg` lag jumped ~12k then recovered. Also saw a consumer rebalance at 03:13.

kai: We rolled a canary of billing-ingest v2.3.1 at 03:05 that included a partitioner tweak (sticky->hash-by-tenant). Could be the partition key change + the rebalance caused some events to be routed differently mid-window.

jess: If the partitioning changed mid-flight ledger's stateful join could miss a span (consumer reading partition A but ledger expected key in partition B). Reprocessing offsets 145700-145900 for affected partitions should reconcile, but we need to be careful about idempotence.

mia: UX note: Console invoice preview shows "-2k credits" as final delta which confused CS; we currently display preview as final until ledger reconciliation completes. We should mark preview as 'in-flight' with tooltip: "pending ledger reconciliation". Filed ENG-8470 with mockups: https://redwood/ENG-8470

oncall-bot: :rotating_light: alert: consumer lag high — group=billing-agg lag=12050 partitions=18 at 2025-07-12T03:15:45Z

sam: Proposed immediate steps:
1) pause the canary/rollback the partitioner change
2) increase consumer parallelism on billing-agg to drain backlog
3) run targeted reprocess job for offsets 145700..145900 on partitions 6,7
I'll open a revert PR and a reprocess job runbook.

leo: Also add a reconciliation marker/event in the ledger when we see partition-key changes so we can automatically detect these holes rather than manual sleuthing.

jess: Starting reprocess now (on my dev cluster) — command I used:
```
./bin/reprocess-range --topic billing.credits.v1 --partitions 6,7 --from 145700 --to 145900 --idempotent
```
Will post updates.

jess: update: reprocess job 50% applied (approx 1k events), consumer lag dropping. ETA ~8m.

jess: done. Reprocess applied ~2,036 events. Invoice preview +2,036 credits now matches ledger. I also reverted canary partitioner (PR #4821) and bumped consumer replicas to 6.

mia: filing a console follow-up to mark preview as pending and add a small explainer for ops. Assigning to UI triage.

sam: great—closing loop. We should add a chaos-check to deploy playbook: when partitioning key changes, run a canary with checksum compare for 10m before full rollout.

leo: +1. I'll open a ticket for automated checksum canary and reconciliation markers.

jess: thanks all. I'll patch the reprocess tool to emit an audit event we can tie to invoice previews.

sam: 👍 closing thread for now; follow-ups in ENG-8470 and the checksum ticket.
